design-bot: New draft banner uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (comments enabled). @maria please review and leave final assets in the "webinar-assets" folder.

jordan (Orbit): Jordan here — confirmed for dry-run and the actual session. I'll bring a sanitized test dataset and an offline demo video as fallback. Happy to coordinate network whitelisting with your infra team.
sasha: Awesome. Action items: devon -> locker vendor + quote by EOD; maria -> legal + design signoff by Apr 20; chris -> create Zoom webinar, RTMP endpoint, backup VM, and upload tech runbook by Apr 22; paul -> finalize shipping list and RSVP cap. I'll draft the run-of-show and post by EOD. :thumbsup:
